title: "V1040 assign_immutable"
description: "Only var bindings can be assigned; let bindings and parameters are immutable (design §8.1)."
---

An error from the `resolve` phase. `sakura explain V1040` prints this explanation offline.

Only `var` bindings can be assigned; `let` bindings and parameters are immutable (design §8.1).

Wrong:

```sakura
let n = 0
n = n + 1
```

Fixed:

```sakura
var n = 0
n = n + 1
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V1040_assign_immutable.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V1040_assign_immutable.sakura), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn bump() -> Int {
  let x = 1
  x = 2
  x
}
```
